name: lincos-mcp-connector

tools.name: search_orders
tools.description: Search sales orders by number, customer name, state, or date range. Returns order list with key details.

query.description: Search by order number, customer name, or reference

tools.name: get_order_details
tools.description: Get full details of a sales order including items, totals, shipping info, and FSM state history. Provide either order_id or order_number.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the product catalog by code, name, brand, or category. Returns product list with prices and availability.

query.description: Search by product code, name, or brand

tools.name: get_product_stock
tools.description: Get stock levels for a product across all warehouses and shelf locations. Provide product_code or product_id.

product_code.description: Product code to check stock for

product_id.description: Product ID to check stock for

tools.name: search_purchase_orders
tools.description: Search purchase orders by number, supplier, state, or date range. Returns PO list with supplier info and totals.

query.description: Search by PO number, supplier name, or reference

tools.name: get_po_details
tools.description: Get full details of a purchase order including line items, received quantities, and prices. Provide po_id or po_number.

tools.name: get_my_tasks
tools.description: Get your current tasks from the ERP calendar/task system. Filter by state: doing, todo, idea, on_hold, or all.

state.description: Filter by task state: doing, todo, idea, on_hold, or all

tools.name: get_cashflow
tools.description: Get cashflow entries — receivables (DUE), payments, and balances. Filter by type, date range, partner, or open/closed status.

type.description: Filter by cashflow type: DUE (receivables/payables), PAYMENT, or all

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search customers and organizations by name, email, phone, or tax ID.

query.description: Search by customer name, email, phone, or tax ID

tools.name: get_stock_value
tools.description: Get stock value report, optionally grouped by manufacturer, category, or warehouse.

group_by.description: Group stock value by: manufacturer, category, or warehouse

tools.name: get_order_items
tools.description: Get the line items (products, quantities, prices) for a sales order. Requires order_id (fsm_instance_id). Use search_orders first to find the ID.

tools.name: search_all
tools.description: Search across all entities at once: orders, products, purchase orders, and customers. Useful when you don't know which entity to search. Returns up to N results per type.

query.description: Search text — will be searched across orders, products, purchase orders, and customers

tools.name: search_after_sales
tools.description: Search after-sales cases: returns, warranties, repairs. Filter by state, partner, or specific case ID. Shows product, warranty status, problem description, and current state.

state_code.description: FSM state code filter (e.g., state_af_received, state_af_in_progress, state_af_completed)

tools.name: search_invoices
tools.description: Search billing invoices. Filter by status (draft/confirmed/sent/paid), type (invoice/proforma/credit_note), direction (outgoing/incoming), date range, or partner. Provide invoice_id for full details.

invoice_id.description: Specific invoice ID for detail view

status.description: Filter by status (draft, confirmed, sent, paid, cancelled)

invoice_direction.description: Filter by direction: outgoing (we issued) or incoming (received from supplier)

tools.name: get_arriving_shipments
tools.description: Get purchase orders currently in transit (shipped/in-port/customs-cleared). Shows supplier, ETA, external reference, and current state. No parameters needed.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Get your recent notifications — DMs, @mentions, and system alerts. Optionally filter to unread only.

tools.name: get_supplier_profile
tools.description: Get detailed supplier/partner profile: contacts, lead times, payment terms, recent POs, product count. Requires partner_id — use search_customers first to find it.

partner_id.description: Partner/supplier ID. Use search_customers first to find the ID.

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search business emails by subject, sender, or text. Can also fetch a specific message by ID or all messages in a thread. Requires account_id for listing.

search.description: Search text — matches subject, sender address, or sender name

account_id.description: Email account ID to search in (required for listing, optional with message_id)

message_id.description: Specific message ID for full detail view

thread_id.description: Thread ID to get all messages in a conversation (requires account_id)

tools.name: search_calendar
tools.description: Search calendar events: tasks, leaves, meetings. Filter by date range, user, event type, FSM state, division, tags. Broader than get_my_tasks — shows all visible events.

event_id.description: Specific event ID for detail view

start_date.description: Start date filter (YYYY-MM-DD) — events ending on or after this date

end_date.description: End date filter (YYYY-MM-DD) — events starting on or before this date

event_type.description: Filter by event type: TASK, LEAVE, OTHER

fsm_type_code.description: Filter by FSM type code: TASK, LEAVE, etc.

state_code.description: Filter by FSM state code (e.g., state_task_doing, state_task_todo)

tools.name: get_purchasing_dashboard
tools.description: Purchasing analytics dashboard: KPIs (open POs, low stock items, goods to order, pending payments, overdue deliveries), recent POs with amounts, and upcoming payment dues. No parameters needed.

tools.name: get_goods_to_order
tools.description: Products that need to be ordered — stock is below the reorder threshold. Shows product code, manufacturer, ordered quantity, current stock, arriving quantity, and whether it's low stock.

tools.name: search_knowledge_base
tools.description: Search the AI knowledge base: guidelines, rules, processes, decisions, anti-patterns. Filter by type, domain, status, or full-text search.

search.description: Full-text search across titles, descriptions, content, and tags

knowledge_type.description: Filter by type (e.g., guideline, rule, process, anti_pattern, decision)

domain.description: Filter by domain/area (e.g., purchasing, sales, warehouse, finance)

applies_to.description: Filter by target (e.g., all, erp, webshop, warehouse)

tools.name: search_transfers
tools.description: Search warehouse transfers between locations. Provide transfer_id for full detail with line items, or filter by state, source/destination warehouse.

transfer_id.description: Specific transfer ID for detail view with line items

tools.name: get_email_accounts
tools.description: List email accounts accessible to the current user (company and personal). Use account_id from results to search emails with search_emails. Shows account name, email address, sync status, unread count.

tools.name: get_conversations
tools.description: List all team messaging conversations: channels (role-based, project, announcement), direct messages, and group chats. Shows display name, type, last message, unread count, and mentions.

tools.name: get_arriving_goods
tools.description: Product-level view of incoming stock from open purchase orders. Shows each product code, quantity, manufacturer, supplier, PO reference, ETA, and state. ALWAYS use product_code filter to avoid 1500+ row responses. Supports partial match (e.g. "STD-5145" matches "STD-5145E 230V"). Includes both ZRT and KFT company POs.

product_code.description: Filter by product code (partial match, e.g. "STD-5145" matches STD-5145E 230V)

tools.name: get_employees
tools.description: List employees with HR details: employment status, start/end dates, medical fitness expiry, division, employer companies. Useful for team overview and HR queries.

tools.name: get_leave_balance
tools.description: Your leave balances: vacation days, sick leave, etc. Shows total, used, pending, carried over, and remaining days per leave type and year.

tools.name: get_warehouses
tools.description: List physical warehouses with codes, names, types, and company assignments. Useful for warehouse IDs needed by search_transfers and stock tools.

tools.name: get_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays by country and year. Defaults to Hungary (HU) and current year. Supports: HU, RO, SK, BG, CZ, DE.

country_code.description: Country code (default HU). Options: HU, RO, SK, BG, CZ, DE

year.description: Year to get holidays for (default current year)

tools.name: get_settings
tools.description: Company settings and configuration values. Shows setting codes, values, descriptions. Useful for checking feature flags, API keys presence, and system behavior.

tools.name: get_divisions
tools.description: Company divisions/departments with codes, names, and contact emails. Reference data for employee and task queries.

tools.name: get_stock_availability
tools.description: Free vs reserved stock per product and warehouse account. Shows total quantity, available (free) quantity, and reserved quantity. Complements get_product_stock (shelf-level) and get_stock_value (monetary).

tools.name: get_incoming_invoices
tools.description: Incoming supplier invoices with AI-extracted data (amounts, dates, tax IDs), payment status, and matched receipts. Useful for AP overview and invoice processing.

tools.name: get_cs_tickets
tools.description: Customer service tickets from the webshop. AI-triaged with priority, sentiment, category, and response suggestions. Shows open tickets sorted by urgency.

tools.name: get_categories
tools.description: Product categories list (ID and name). Reference data useful for filtering products by category.

tools.name: get_manufacturers
tools.description: Product manufacturers/brands list (ID and name). Reference data useful for filtering products by manufacturer.

tools.name: get_feedback_reports
tools.description: User feedback reports and bug reports submitted through the feedback assistant. Shows reporter, page, description, status, and screenshots.

tools.name: get_order_plans
tools.description: Purchasing draft plans — supplier order planning documents. Shows plan name, supplier, row count, and planning horizon. Used for coordinating bulk purchases.

tools.name: get_replenishment_rules
tools.description: Warehouse stock replenishment rules: min/target/max quantities per product per warehouse. Includes gap analysis, days of stock, stock status (ok/low/critical/overstocked/out_of_stock).

tools.name: get_pickup_order_summary
tools.description: Products needed for in-store pickup orders. Shows product, ordered quantity, stock at each warehouse (Budapest, Debrecen, Depo), whether stock is available at the pickup location. Useful for warehouse staff preparing pickup orders.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: User dashboard configuration: bookmarks, widget settings, available widgets and pages. Shows personalized ERP layout.

tools.name: get_delivery_methods
tools.description: Delivery/shipping methods for the current company: courier services, pickup locations, EXW options. Reference data for order processing.

tools.name: get_payment_methods
tools.description: Payment methods for the current company: bank transfer, card, cash, COD, etc. Reference data for order and invoice processing.

tools.name: get_collectible_goods
tools.description: Orders and documents ready for picking/collection in the warehouse. Shows partner name, document type, order reference. Used by warehouse staff to see what needs to be prepared.

tools.name: get_stock_distribution
tools.description: Warehouse transfer proposals: planned stock movements between warehouses. Shows source/destination, status, item count, weight, truck utilization %, and approval status.

tools.name: get_cmr_documents
tools.description: CMR transport documents (international consignment notes). Shows reference, date, sender, consignee, and attached invoices.

tools.name: get_payment_allocations
tools.description: Payment-to-invoice allocations: how payments are matched to dues/invoices. Shows source payment, target invoice, allocated amount, partner, and currency.

tools.name: get_medical_fitness_alerts
tools.description: Employees with expiring or expired medical fitness certificates (within 60 days). Shows alert level (expired/critical/warning/ok), days remaining, and employee details. HR compliance tool.

tools.name: get_changelog
tools.description: App changelog — recent releases, features, fixes, and improvements. Shows version, entry type, title, description, and deploy date.

tools.name: get_job_postings
tools.description: Job postings with application counts, required skills, salary range, and deadline. Shows active and past postings for the current company.

tools.name: get_sales_analysis
tools.description: Product sales analytics per shop: purchase price, retail price, margins, sales volumes (yearly/monthly), stock levels, competitor prices, discount status, and ad activity. CRITICAL for evaluating product performance and purchasing decisions. Requires at least one filter: product_code (partial match like "STD-5"), manufacturer, or category.

product_code.description: Filter by product code (partial match, e.g. "STD-5" for all STD-5xxx)

tools.name: get_product_prices
tools.description: Product pricing per shop: purchase price (base + original currency), selling price, discount %, shopper group prices. Requires shop_id array (22=lincos.hu HUF, 27=lincos.shop EUR, 15=b2b.lincos.shop EUR).

shop_id.description: Shop IDs to get prices for (e.g. [22] for lincos.hu, [27] for lincos.shop, [22,27] for both)

tools.name: get_published_products
tools.description: Which products are published on which webshops. Shows product code, manufacturer, product type, and published status per shop hostname. Useful for checking webshop visibility.

tools.name: get_product_suppliers
tools.description: List of product suppliers: partner name, default currency, production time (days), delivery time (days), and linked manufacturer brand. Useful for lead time and sourcing decisions.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Get information about the currently authenticated user: name, email, company, and accessible modules.

tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List all ERP modules/pages that the current user has access to.

tools.name: get_currency_rates
tools.description: Get current exchange rates. Optionally filter by specific currency code (EUR, USD, etc.).

currency.description: Specific currency code (e.g., "EUR", "USD"). Omit to get all rates.

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Look up translations in the ERP translation database. Search by caption code or text.

query.description: Caption code or search text to look up in the translation database

language.description: Language code (en, hu, de, ro, sk, cs, bg). Omit to get all languages.

tools.name: get_fsm_workflow
tools.description: Get the state machine diagram for a workflow type: SO (sales orders), PO (purchase orders), PICK (pick lists), TASK, DUE, PAYMENT, AF (after-sales), etc. Shows all states and transitions.

type.description: FSM type code: SO (sales orders), PO (purchase orders), PICK (pick lists), DUE, PAYMENT, TASK, AF (after-sales), etc.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List ERP users. Useful for finding user IDs for task assignment or @mentions in comments. Optionally filter by name.

query.description: Optional search text to filter users by name

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task in the ERP task/calendar system. The task gets an FSM lifecycle (todo → doing → done). Assigned to the current user by default.

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Update an existing task: change title, description, dates, priority, tags, etc. Provide the event_id and only the fields you want to change.

event_id.description: Event ID of the task to update

tools.name: add_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task or order. Supports markdown. Optionally @mention users by ID to send them a DM notification.

event_id.description: Task or order event_id to comment on

mentioned_user_ids.description: User IDs to @mention (triggers DM notification to each mentioned user)

tools.name: trigger_action
tools.description: Trigger an FSM state transition on a task, sales order, purchase order, or other entity. Common actions: TASK_START, TASK_COMPLETE, SO_PROCESS, SO_SHIP, PO_CONFIRM. Use get_fsm_workflow to see available transitions for a workflow type.

fsm_instance_id.description: FSM instance ID (from the task, order, or PO)

event_code.description:
FSM event code to trigger. Common codes:
- Tasks: TASK_START, TASK_COMPLETE, TASK_HOLD, TASK_RESUME, TASK_DISCARD
- Sales Orders: SO_PROCESS, SO_SHIP, SO_CANCEL, SO_WAIT_FOR_GOODS
- Purchase Orders: PO_CONFIRM, PO_RECEIVE, PO_CANCEL

comment.description: Optional comment for the state transition
